name: Preset validator & compliance check
description: Verify whether an image or document looks consistent with published portal requirements (US State Dept, UK HMPO, EU Schengen, VFS Global) without modifying the file.

seo.metaTitle: Preset validator & compliance check — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Verify whether an image or document looks consistent with published portal requirements (US State Dept, UK HMPO, EU Schengen, VFS Global) without modifying the file. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/photo/spot-rejection-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: Preset validator & compliance check processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/photo/spot-rejection-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.q: Does Preset validator & compliance check upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. Preset validator & compliance check executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/photo/spot-rejection-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.q: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Preset validator & compliance check?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/spot_rejection.json or open /tools/spot-rejection?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
